html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Die in the Guild of Shadows Center for Stealthness and Backstabbery off Level 4 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Seeking Secrets, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Die in the Guild of Shadows Center for Stealthness and Backstabbery off Level 4 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

We're getting a better understanding of what is going on with the resurrection system. The Guild of Shadows seems to be involved somehow, but for what purpose? We can thwart their plans only after we learn why.

Go and die in the Guild of Shadows Center for Stealthness and Backstabbery off Level 4 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet back here with me in the Shadow's Gate.

Turn-in:

More intelligence to report? Well, I'm no super-spy or anything *wink!*, but I'll help if I can.

Objectives:

  • Secret Strategy: Possom Promise ×1

Client level range: 45–100
